title: PokeDash Official
description: The official modpack for the PokeDash cobblemon server!
body:
Step into a new adventure with Pokedash, a carefully crafted Cobblemon experience that brings together exploration, progression, and community play. Built for survival and multiplayer servers, this pack combines the best of Pokémon-inspired gameplay with essential quality-of-life features.

Features include:

Cobblemon – Catch, train, and battle Pokémon in the Minecraft world.

Cobble Breeding – Breed your Pokémon to grow your team and unlock new strategies.

Lootr – Explore dungeons and structures with instanced loot, ensuring every player has a fair shot at rewards.

Legendaries – Hunt down rare and powerful Legendary Pokémon for the ultimate challenge.

Hunts – Hunt pokemon for amazing rewards.

Cobble Aura's – Unlock rare cosmetic particles for your pokemon!

Raid dens – Battle boss pokemon either alone or with friends for rewards!

Dynamax/Mega Evolution - Allows you to megaevolve and dynamax your pokemon.

And way more!

A selection of performance and quality-of-life mods to make the game smoother, more immersive, and more fun.

Whether you’re a competitive trainer, a shiny hunter, or an adventurer exploring the wild, this modpack is designed to provide a balanced and enjoyable experience for both solo and server play.

Catch, train, battle—your journey starts here!
